note: What GitHub is expected to answer to conformance.ts's script, written first from GitHub's REST description 1.1.4 (github-schemas.json) and docs.github.com, then REPLACED by the real App's answers on the first real run (github.com-2026-09-24.json, `Manifest (local dev)`, App 5068172, org Manifest-local-dev, a FREE organisation) — every step but C13's `team` answer is now measured (the D5 plan, Task 6, Decision 7). The fake is held to it on every `pnpm test`. The first real run (`make github-conformance`) writes github.com-<date>.json beside this file; a person then replaces these entries with GitHub's answers, sets `source` to `github.com <date>, App <id>`, and the FAKE is fixed until the test is green again. A disagreement goes to the fake, never to this file — unless the real run shows this file wrong. `unknown: true` means the documentation is silent and the test asserts nothing for that step; `pendingTask: N` means the fake does not implement it until Task N, and the test skips it by name.
